title: About the Collection platform
paragraph1: Welcome to the Collection Platform of the National Collection for Dutch Architecture and Urban Planning, managed by Nieuwe Instituut. We invite you to wander through a treasure trove of archives, objects, people, and publications. Click through, explore, and discover the rich history of Dutch architecture and urban planning. Whether you are an enthusiast, student, or professional, the platform offers a journey through the past, present, and future. Be inspired by the most surprising discoveries from the collection.
paragraph2: The collection is physically and digitally accessible to everyone: students, curators, architects, scientists, educational institutions, restorers, and anyone else interested in the built environment. The diversity of the collection and the combination of archives and library make extensive research possible. Whether you are looking for the life and work of architects, interested in the design process, or the use of different materials. Moreover, the National Collection holds a central place in the research and exhibition program of the Nieuwe Instituut.
